definitions.explanation: The transmission of electrical current through a material. Used in physics and engineering to describe the ability of a substance to conduct electricity.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{素材|そざい}→素材：09492_sozai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{電導|でんどう}⟦{性|せい}→性：09880_sei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{優|すぐ}れている→優れる：02119_sugureru⟧。
examples.english: This material has excellent electrical conductivity.

examples.japanese: {超|ちょう}{電導|でんどう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{特定|とくてい}→特定：04275_tokutei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{温度|おんど}→温度：00333_ondo⟧⟦{以下|いか}→以下：01294_ika⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{電気|でんき}{抵抗|ていこう}→電気抵抗：25186_denkiteikou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ゼロ→ゼロ：01011_zero⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{現象|げんしょう}→現象：02718_genshou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧。
examples.english: Superconductivity is the phenomenon in which electrical resistance drops to zero below a certain temperature.

notes:
A physics term composed of {電|でん} (electricity) and {導|どう} (conduct/guide). Often interchangeable with ⟦{伝導|でんどう}→伝導：24991_dendou⟧ in the context of electrical conduction, though ⟦{伝導|でんどう}→伝導：24991_dendou⟧ can also refer to heat conduction.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {電導|でんどう}⟦{性|せい}→性：09880_sei⟧: electrical conductivity
- {電導|でんどう}⟦{率|りつ}→率：03802_ritsu⟧: conductivity rate
- {超|ちょう}{電導|でんどう}: superconductivity
- {電導|でんどう}⟦{体|たい}→体：09872_tai⟧: conductor (of electricity)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{伝導|でんどう}→伝導：24991_dendou⟧: conduction (broader term, includes heat and electrical conduction)
- ⟦{導電|どうでん}→導電：30048_douden⟧: electrical conduction (alternate word order, same meaning)
- ⟦{通電|つうでん}→通電：30050_tsuuden⟧: passing of electrical current (focus on the act of sending current through)

USAGE:
The compound {超|ちょう}{電導|でんどう} (superconductivity) is one of the most commonly encountered uses of this word. In scientific contexts, {電導|でんどう} specifically refers to electrical conduction, while ⟦{伝導|でんどう}→伝導：24991_dendou⟧ is the broader physical concept.
